from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document extracted from the input collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The case cause of action (案由), e.g., '执行案由 - 刑事', '民事', '行政'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
